This Statement of Work (the “Agreement”) is between the RVRWRK LLC (“Contractor”) and the City of
Doral (“Client”), effective November 15, 2026.
This statement of work is not binding or enforceable until signed by both Client and Contractor.
Client: City of Doral Contractor: RVRWRK LLC.
Mike Sarasti
The Client seeks to engage and hire Contractor to provide Client’s employees with our unique process
mapping and analytics service. The service draws on various industry best practices and the extensive
municipal experience of the Contractor’s principals. The mapping service uses an interview technique
that reveals detailed insights, empowering employees to make meaningful and impactful change
throughout the government.
The Contractor’s service will help participants produce and document extensive step-by-step process
data, and it will deliver guidance designed to unlock service delivery improvement. The effort will support
the City of Doral Department’s goal to create documentation that supports the municipality's strategic and
innovation objectives. By more deeply understanding day-to-day operations, process participants,
dependencies, and workflows, employees will be positioned to make significant enhancements to
customer experiences.
● Facilitate current state maps via our interview consultant (up to 200 calls).
● This builds on previous work; pricing includes carry forward unused calls from the February 2026
SOW
● Provide ongoing system access to full process analytics - SOPS, process summaries, downtime,
customer perspectives, etc.

RVRWRK LLC (“River Work”) will serve as the Contractor for this project. The company founders have
infused over 60 years of combined municipal government experience into RVRWRK’s interview design,
process analysis, and enabling technology. With a passion for improving customer experiences and
empowering employees to deliver impact, the team has developed unique, tested, human-centered
systems that swiftly deliver deep, high-quality insights, helping organizations save money, time, and
resources.
has more than 18 years of government experience evaluating government
processes, modernizing technology, and improving the usability of resident services. He was most
recently the City of Miami’s CIO/Director of Innovation and Technology, a position charged with
driving innovation, technology operations, collaboration, and data-driven strategy across
municipal government. While there, he co-founded the Miami Innovation Academy which trained
over 400 city employees to apply innovation techniques in their daily work. Highlights included
significant improvements to Procurement and Business Licensing.
, through his consulting company, Change Agents Training, will serve as a
subcontractor and provide training and support. Brian is an innovation and performance initiative
expert who helped found the Denver Peak Academy, a nationally-recognized employee led
process improvement program that saved $25 million for the City and County of Denver (13,000+
FTEs) that included process improvement workshops and mentor programs. He holds certificates
in Lean, Six Sigma, and Change Management, and has published a book on the topic of
innovation and process improvement in government (Peak Performance, Governing Books,
2016). Brian has more than 15 years of experience working in government at both the state and
municipal levels. He is an AmeriCorps alumni, former Policy Director for the Pennsylvania
Department of Aging, Legislative Specialist for AARP, and Government Relations Director for
Denver International Airport. Brian currently serves as Faculty in Urban Leadership at the
University of Nevada at Las Vegas (UNLV).
Contractor will invoice the City of Doral for the access and services described in this Statement of Work
upon initiation of the engagement. Client will remit payment Net 30 days from receipt of a correct invoice.
No travel is anticipated and no travel expenses will be billed under this Statement of Work. If travel
becomes necessary at Client’s request, Contractor will obtain Client’s written approval in advance for
estimated travel costs. Approved travel will be billed at actual cost and will not exceed the approved
estimate without additional written approval.
